may 11 Notes:


Today I took 2 trades, one was a loss and the other was a breakeven trade that I am honestly really surprised didn’t play out. They were both taken during pre-session just because of work. Both good setups.
,
The first trade I took was after we had a low swept, a big expansion that made relative equal highs with asian session highs and we retraced to the ote of the range, and tapped the midnight open, and also rejected out of the top of the nwog, made a  5min rb which I entered off of. I got stopped out pretty quickly, but I would say that this was a good trade. The only problem was that it was a little rangey, but we kept respecting higher time frame bullish rejection blocks, so I thought we would take the high, but we did not. (Screenshot 1)
,
The second trade was a 1h powell model that was lower. we had a 1h rb that rejected out of another 1h rb, and we had engineered liquidity above the ce of the wick and the draw of relative equal highs. We also had a 15m cisd line up with the ce of the wick and a 5min fvg. We tapped the level and made a perfect 5min rb out of it and then the next candle also closed bullish, a perfect reaction to the level, but then we got stopped at breakevn, price swept the low and then went to tp. Good entry model, but maybe the higher time frame context wasn’t aligned and maybe a move aggressive liquidity sweep would have been better. (Screenshot 2 & 3)
,

messages.content_text:
day 1   monday 11th may 
w/l : 1 loss(-200) , 1 win(+1200)
bias :  originally i wanted to see a htf manipulation into the range lower then distribute back to ath from a htf pda . but market open just pumped to ath and es did too meaning there was no longer a bearish smt to push price lower so i waited for a retracement to long .

trade 1:  i wanted to try long from discount of the range on 1min +5min fvg and tdo , i was going to wait until 10am opened but entered just before anyway (could say it was a bit of FOMO) but i was quite confident , price came below tdo on nq while es was just rallying , tapped 0.795 of the range and made a 1min rb out of 5min gap so i entered on the open of it and 10pt sl with 1 mini targetting the closest internal high then got stopped before price came up to my tp . there was also smt at 9:38 low which gave me more confidence .     the mistake i made was entering right before 10am as usually if i wanted to see 10am expand higher it should manipulate lower first and if it doesnt then it probably means the move up is the manipulation ,couldve avoided the loss

trade 2 : i took this trade in pm session , the 2pm 4hr candle opened and manipulated upwards and made an smt at a previous high + cvd divergence , i wanted to see a rebalance of the current price range before a move higher anyway . the rr was worth the risk to me as if i lost the trade id be down 300 on the day which is ok with me but if it hit tp then it would end the day green so i entered when price came into and started to reject a 5min ob with 5pt sl at the highs and 1mini i was targetting just below 0.5 of range for 60pt then i trailed my sl to +200 when i had the chance so even if i was stopped it would mean i ended the day break even .     i did get a bit of fear when price came below the 4hr candle open and started leaving rejection wicks but i didnt mess with my trade and decided i would tp once es took the low and smt was made but then ended up hitting tp before that (edited)
